steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Still no sign of the collectors?

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: No... Pylgia, what about your side?
After scouring for more than ten minutes, the team has only located a few collectors at their designated spots, with the rest having disappeared without a trace.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: The seabed terrain changed earlier than expected. I've checked all our marked locations. Nothing there.
There's an unusual unease in Pylgia's voice over the radio—a clear sign that even she has lost control of the situation.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: There's only one possible area left...
All four of you simultaneously turn to gaze at the vast void.
For the past ten minutes, you have all silently agreed to ignore its existence.
Anyone in their right mind can sense something down there—something so terrifying that none of you dare to voice the worst possibilities.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: The collectors are... probably down there.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: ...The Maw of the Abyss... We've got some serious trouble here.
The Maw of the Abyss—this is the first time you've heard your team members name this enormous void. Dark, cold, harboring untold dangers, devouring all... Truly, no name could be more fitting.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...We should go back.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: ...I understand your worries, but...
Ragnar, upon hearing Pylgia's proposal, showed an uncharacteristic hesitation.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Those collectors are the dive team's life. Shin's whole crew is counting on them! If we go back empty-handed, this mission, no, the expedition would be pointless! Sorry, but I really can't give them up...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: But...
Pylgia's voice carries even more concern.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We've never dived down into the Abyss before. We're clueless about what lies in there.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I can feel it. It's dangerous.
When the champ diver, known for being fearless all the time, uses the word "dangerous," the tension in the air grows even thicker.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Maybe... when the next tide comes and shifts the terrain again, the collectors might resurface from the Abyss, and then...

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: The odds are too low. We can't afford that risk.
Dale's voice, somewhat hoarse, comes through the radio.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Resources are stretched thin. The tech team won't be able to manufacture another batch of collectors for us.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: ...We can't just sit back and watch six months of everyone's work go down the drain...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I'll go.
Pylgia pauses for a moment as if steeling her resolve.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll go alone. You guys take these collectors we've gathered back to base.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: What are you thinking, Pylgia? We're the ones insisting on going in there. We can't let you go in on our behalf, especially not alone!

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: I've been at this gig for ages—can't let a lady dive into that death trap alone. We'll go together. Trust me, it's always better four than one.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: We trust your instincts and skills, but there's no way you can retrieve all of them on your own. I know how capable you are, but you need help.
After a long moment of silence, you hear a soft sigh through the radio.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Anything goes south, turn back. Don't push yourselves...
